collection.title: Vauxhall Meriva 2003 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Meriva 2003 to 2010 model requires a 24" wiper blade for both the drivers and for the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Meriva which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
